headline: Sam Bankman-Fried Sentenced to 25 Years for FTX Fraud in Manhattan Federal Court
summary: Sam Bankman-Fried, the founder of crypto exchange FTX, has been sentenced to 25 years in federal prison for orchestrating a multibillion-dollar fraud. Judge Lewis A. Kaplan handed down the sentence in Manhattan after Bankman-Fried's November 2023 conviction on seven counts including wire fraud, securities fraud, and conspiracy. Prosecutors said the FTX collapse cost customers approximately $8 billion. The Department of Justice called the sentence one of the most significant white-collar prosecutions in recent years.
key_points: Sam Bankman-Fried sentenced to 25 years in federal prison for orchestrating FTX fraud
Convicted in November 2023 on seven counts including wire fraud and securities fraud
Prosecutors estimated approximately $8 billion in customer losses from FTX collapse
Judge Lewis A. Kaplan handed down the sentence at Manhattan federal court
